title: Cohort-anchored rehearsal-to-canary promotion with telemetry-led failsafe
author: Anika Bose
description: Motivation: Improve safety and confidence when promoting models from shadow (rehearsal) to canary by anchoring promotion decisions to per-cohort fidelity checks and a lightweight consensus checkpoint. This PR implements a rehearsal-to-canary promotion flow that runs synthetic smoke tests and telemetry validation against user cohorts, preserves session affinity during promotes, and exposes new observability/alerting for rehearsal fidelity regressions. Summary of changes: - New rehearsal controller that orchestrates phased shadow runs with per-cohort evaluation windows and a consensus checkpoint algorithm that requires agreement across latency, correctness, and top-k freshness metrics before promotion. - Affinity-preserving handoff: session-token mapping persisted during promote to avoid user-visible session drift. - Synthetic rehearsal harness: replayable, budgeted synthetic traffic generator that exercises edge cases and records fidelity snapshots. - Rollback oracle: automatic fast-fail rollback trigger that can take immediate traffic revert and record forensic snapshot for postmortem. - Ops and runbooks: a runbook for on-call to interpret rehearsal diagnostics and a console dashboard for cohort fidelity heatmaps. Implementation notes: The promenade algorithm uses a sliding-window aggregator with per-cohort thresholds derived from baseline historical percentiles. To avoid noisy single-metric flips, the consensus requires two out of three metric gates plus a monotonicity check on recent samples. Default config is conservative; teams can opt into more aggressive thresholds via rollout policy. Backwards compatibility: rollout schemas are extended with a new optional "rehearsal_policy" block. Default behavior when omitted is unchanged (canary flows remain as before). See release notes for migration guidance. Checklist: - [x] Runtime controller and scheduler hooks - [x] Affinity manager integration - [x] Synthetic harness and e2e tests - [x] Console dashboard and alerting - [x] Runbook and operator playbook - [x] Performance microbenchmarks - [x] Migration guide and schema migration path Known limitations: - The initial version requires a short warmup window (30s) and relies on stable cohort sampling; very low-traffic cohorts may need custom thresholds. - Rehearsal replay currently supports HTTP/text workloads; streaming audio/video not in scope for v1. Rollout plan: Feature gated behind "rehearsal_promote" feature flag. Start with internal beta on staging, then opt-in customers, then broad GA after 2 weeks of telemetry stability.

commit 1: add rehearsal controller, threshold engine and scheduler integration
commit 2: implement affinity preservation and session mapping store

changes:
Key files changed (high-level):
- src/rollout/rehearsal_controller.go: new controller implementing phased shadow runs and consensus checkpointing
- pkg/serving/affinity/affinity_manager.go: persist/restore session-token mapping during promotes
- ops/sim/rehearsal_harness.py: synthetic traffic generator and replay CLI
- test/e2e/rehearsal_promote_test.go: end-to-end smoke and regression tests
- console/dashboards/rehearsal_fidelity.jsonnet: cohort heatmap and gating dashboard
- docs/runbooks/rehearsal_playbook.md: operator runbook and diagnostics guide
- infra/telemetry/alerts/rehearsal_fidelity_rules.yaml: new alerts and thresholds
- api/schemas/rollout_schema_v2.json: optional rehearsal_policy block
Plus small updates across CI configs and mocks for deterministic tests.

release_notes: Added cohort-anchored rehearsal-to-canary promotion flow with telemetry-driven consensus checks and affinity-preserving handoff. Feature gated behind rehearsal_promote. Includes new console dashboard, runbook, and rollback oracle. Backwards compatible unless rehearsal_policy is specified in rollout schema.

notes_for_oncall: If rehearsal_fidelity alert triggers: check cohort heatmaps in console -> identify cohorts failing consensus -> use runbook to either pause promotions or revert via rollback oracle. For urgent revert: POST to /api/v1/rollouts/{id}/revert with immediate=true. Ensure feature flag is toggled if noise persists.
motivation_background: Teams have been promoting models from shadow to canary manually because single-metric gates produced too many false positives. This PR codifies a reproducible rehearsal step that reduces manual toil, preserves user sessions, and makes promotion decisions explainable by tying them to cohort-aware telemetry snapshots.
testing_and_perf: Microbenchmarks show rehearsal controller adds ~0.8% CPU on control-plane nodes and median 2ms additional scheduling latency under typical load. Synthetic harness exercised 10k requests without observable downstream latency amplification. E2E: 3 flaky tests initially fixed by deterministic seeding and polling improvements.
operational_impact: Minor: new alerting and dashboard may increase alert noise initially; recommend oncall to treat rehearsal_fidelity as low-severity until tunings complete. Storage: session mapping persisted to existing rollout metadata store (small disk increase).
security_considerations: No new secrets. Rehearsal harness runs with the same network constraints as existing shadow traffic. Access to rollback endpoints is RBAC protected; added audit events for promote/revert actions.
migration_notes: If customers run strict schema validation, add rehearsal_policy as optional block with example in docs. Existing rollout configs remain valid. Migration script: scripts/migrate_rollouts_v2.sh (included as convenience).
